news.title: Lexi Potter on a whirlwind few weeks for club and country
news.title_zh: 莱克西·波特在俱乐部和国家队的几周旋风
news.body_en: The rise of Lexi Potter from Chelsea Academy graduate to regularly featuring for Sonia Bompastor’s team and earning her first senior England cap may come as a surprise to some, but those who have followed her career closely will have understood she was destined for the top. Breaking records from an early age, Potter became the youngest player in women’s football history to sign a professional contract when she penned her first deal at Chelsea in 2023 at the age of 17. After two successful campaigns on loan with Crystal Palace, the midfielder earned her first Blues appearance at the start of last season when she came on as a 72nd-minute substitute in our 4-0 win against Paris FC in October. By March, she had played her way to a first-team start, which came at home against Brighton & Hove Albion. Bompastor’s faith was rewarded with a goal from Potter in a 2-1 win over the Seagulls. It was a sign of what was to come. After ten games in all competitions this season, the 20-year-old has featured nine times, scoring once. In the Women’s Super League, she has played 376 minutes - only seven of our players have spent more time on the pitch than Potter. Of course then, it was no wonder that she was on England head coach Sarina Wiegman’s radar when it was time to make her selections for the October internationals. And sure enough, she became England Women’s legacy number 244 when she was named on the teamsheet against Greece in Leicester. Shy and humble, Potter says she’s not yet processed making her senior England debut. But if her form is anything to go by, the spotlight on her is not going away anytime soon. ‘No, not yet,’ she says when asked if the night at the King Power Stadium has sunk in. ‘It's been a quick turnaround from the international break to coming back at Chelsea, but it's been a really good few weeks, and definitely a time I'll never forget. 244 🦁 ❤️Lexi Potter is set to make her #Lionesses debut tonight! 👊 pic.twitter.com/CTrtTOyMxu ‘It was really special. It's something that you always work towards as a young girl, and I'm very grateful and very proud to have done that.’ If anything were to highlight how Potter has remained grounded, it’s how she describes getting the call from Wiegman. ‘I was just at home, in my room, and I wasn't expecting it at all,’ she explains. ‘So when I got the call, I was really happy and very excited.’ Chelsea supporters have seen Potter’s relationship with Keira Walsh blossom on and off the field at club level. That meant the youngster had a ready-made mentor when she joined the senior England camp earlier this month. ‘There aren't many players better in the number six role than Keira to learn from, and I'm very lucky to get the opportunity to be playing alongside her at the moment,’ Potter continued. ‘There are a lot of things in her game that I can learn from and hopefully add to mine, but as the minutes go by, hopefully the partnership will just continue to get stronger. Hopefully we can go very far.’ On current evidence, it appears that the partnership will continue to go far, as Potter suggests. For both club and country.
news.body_zh: 莱克西·波特从切尔西学院毕业，成为索尼娅·邦帕斯特队的常客，并首次代表英格兰国家队出场，这可能会让一些人感到惊讶，但那些密切关注她职业生涯的人会明白她注定会登上顶峰。波特从小就打破纪录，2023年，年仅17岁的波特在切尔西签下了自己的第一笔合同，成为女足历史上签下职业合同最年轻的球员。在租借到水晶宫两次成功的赛季后，这位中场球员在上赛季初首次为蓝军出场，在10月份我们4-0战胜巴黎FC的比赛中，她在第72分钟替补出场。到了三月，她已经在主场对阵布莱顿的比赛中获得了一线队的首发机会。庞帕斯托的信念得到了回报，波特的进球帮助球队 2-1 战胜了海鸥队。这是即将发生的事情的征兆。本赛季各项赛事出场十场后，这位20岁的球员出场九次，打进一球。在女足超级联赛中，她出场了 376 分钟——我们的球员中只有 7 人比波特在球场上花费的时间更长。当然，当英格兰队主教练萨琳娜·维格曼（Sarina Wiegman）为十月国际比赛选拔她时，也就不足为奇了。果然，当她在莱斯特城对阵希腊队的比赛中入选球队名单时，她就成为了英格兰女足的传奇号码 244 号。波特害羞而谦逊，她说她还没有准备好在英格兰成年队首秀。但如果从她的状态来看，她的聚光灯不会很快消失。 “不，还没有，”当被问及在王权球场的夜晚是否已经深入人心时，她说道。“从国际比赛日到回到切尔西，这是一个很快的转变，但这几周真的很美好，绝对是我永远不会忘记的时光。” 244 🦁❤️莱克西·波特今晚将首次亮相#Lionesses！ 👊 pic.twitter.com/CTrtTOyMxu “这真的很特别。这是你作为一个年轻女孩总是要努力实现的目标，我非常感激并且非常自豪能够做到这一点。”如果有什么事情能够凸显波特是如何保持脚踏实地的，那就是她如何描述接到韦格曼的电话。 “我当时只是在家里，在我的房间里，我根本没想到会发生这种事，”她解释道。 “所以当我接到电话时，我真的很高兴也很兴奋。”切尔西的支持者们看到了波特与凯拉·沃尔什在俱乐部球场内外的关系蓬勃发展。这意味着当这位年轻球员本月早些时候加入英格兰成年队训练营时，她已经有了一位现成的导师。 “在六号位上，没有多少球员比凯拉更值得学习，我很幸运现在有机会与她并肩作战，”波特继续说道。 “她的比赛中有很多东西我可以学习，并希望能补充到我的东西中，但随着时间的流逝，希望我们的合作关系能够继续变得更加牢固。”希望我们能走得更远。”根据目前的证据，正如波特所暗示的那样，这种伙伴关系似乎将继续走得更远。对于俱乐部和国家队来说。

news.title: Danny Welbeck on leadership, family and honouring our communities
news.title_zh: 丹尼·维尔贝克谈领导力、家庭和尊重我们的社区
news.body_en: As part of Black History Month, Chelsea FC and Football Black List brought together Danny Welbeck and Football Black List co-founder Leon Mann for a conversation on leadership, family and community. It reflects Chelsea’s ‘Beyond Blue’ approach: building a more inclusive culture, increasing representation and tackling bias in any form. Danny highlights the importance of giving everyone a voice and creating a safe environment. The conversation also ties into this year’s theme, 'Honouring Our Communities'. Danny reflects on how his family shaped his career, his values and his approach to leadership. He and Leon discuss what leadership means in football today, the value of positive role models, and the responsibility experienced players have to support and create opportunities for the next generation. Football Black List celebrates the achievements of Black professionals across football, with African and Caribbean heritage at its heart. Co-founded by Leon Mann and Rodney Hinds, it champions Black excellence, increases visibility and representation, and backs the next generation of leaders in the game. Watch the extended Danny Welbeck × Leon Mann conversation with Football Black List below.
news.body_zh: 作为黑人历史月的一部分，切尔西足球俱乐部和足球黑名单将丹尼·维尔贝克和足球黑名单联合创始人莱昂·曼聚集在一起，就领导力、家庭和社区进行了对话。它反映了切尔西的“超越蓝色”方法：建立更具包容性的文化，增加代表性并解决任何形式的偏见。丹尼强调了让每个人都有发言权和创造安全环境的重要性。这次对话也与今年的主题“尊重我们的社区”相关。丹尼反思了他的家庭如何塑造他的职业生涯、价值观和领导方式。他和莱昂讨论了领导力在当今足球界的意义、积极榜样的价值，以及经验丰富的球员为下一代提供支持和创造机会的责任。 《足球黑名单》庆祝黑人专业人士在足球领域取得的成就，以非洲和加勒比传统为核心。该组织由莱昂·曼 (Leon Mann) 和罗德尼·海因兹 (Rodney Hinds) 共同创立，倡导黑人的卓越品质，提高知名度和代表性，并支持下一代运动领袖。请观看下面丹尼·维尔贝克 × 莱昂·曼与《足球黑名单》的延长对话。

news.title: Flash sale: Get 20 per cent off our home kit now!

news.body_en: To celebrate the Blues' impressive Premier League victory at Everton, we have launched a 20 per cent online flash sale on this season's home shirt for supporters. Xabi Alonso's side followed up our 5-1 victory over Bournemouth with an impressive display at the Hill Dickinson Stadium. Pedro Neto scored both goals on Merseyside, ensuring the Blues returned south with all three points. There are big games ahead, with Tottenham Hotspur and Manchester United visiting Stamford Bridge in the top flight either side of a Carabao Cup trip to Anfield. Supporters can get match-ready by purchasing this season's home kit, with a three-day flash sale online, which is now live here. The offer runs until midnight on Thursday and can be activated by using the code HOME20 at the checkout.

news.title: Mike Penders breaks 21-year Chelsea record after Premier League debut
news.title_zh: 迈克·潘德斯 (Mike Penders) 首次亮相英超打破切尔西 21 年纪录
news.body_en: Mike Penders became Chelsea’s youngest goalkeeper in Premier League history when he replaced Emiliano Martinez in the second half of Saturday’s victory at Everton. The Belgian came on to make his English top-flight debut at the age of 21 years and 78 days, surpassing Lenny Pidgeley as our youngest keeper in the league since 1992. While Penders now holds the Premier League record for the Blues, our all-time youngest goalkeeper remains Kingsley Whiffen. Whiffen was just 16 years and 157 days old when he made his solitary appearance away to Leicester City in Division One in 1967. Whiffen is followed by Steve Francis (17 years, 130 days) and Les Fridge (17 years, 251 days) as our youngest keepers. Here is a closer look at the five youngest goalkeepers to feature for Chelsea in the Premier League era after Penders broke the record, which had stood for over 20 years… Penders was called into action as a second-half substitute at the Hill Dickinson Stadium on Saturday, replacing the injured Martinez. The young Belgian, who spent last season on loan at Strasbourg, showed great composure under pressure. One dominant punch on the edge of the box caught the eye as he helped us see out a first league clean sheet since January. Charlton Athletic (h) – 7 May 2005 Academy graduate Pidgeley previously held the Premier League record. Pidgeley was our third-choice keeper, behind the great Petr Cech and Carlo Cudicini, in the title-winning seasons of 2004/05 and 2005/06. He made his Blues bow on the day we lifted the Premier League trophy for the first time, brought on by Jose Mourinho late into our eventual 1-0 success over Charlton. He played one more game the following season before moving on to Millwall. Manchester United (h) – 15 August 2004 Petr Cech was not long 22 when he made his Chelsea debut on the opening day of that incredible 2004/05 season. He kept a clean sheet against Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, setting the tone for a record-breaking campaign and career. Cech has kept the most clean sheets in Premier League history, and at Chelsea went on to win four Premier League titles, four FA Cups and, of course, the Champions League. After three successful years on loan at Atletico Madrid, Thibaut Courtois returned to Stamford Bridge to make his Premier League debut on the opening weekend of the 2014/15 season. The towering Belgian displaced Cech between the posts that year, helping the Blues claim the Premier League title. Southampton (a) – 4 December 2024 Rounding off the top five is Filip Jorgensen. Having signed from Villarreal in the summer of 2024, Jorgensen made his first Premier League appearance during a big midweek victory against Southampton. news.body_zh: 迈克·潘德斯在周六战胜埃弗顿的下半场比赛中取代埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯，成为切尔西英超历史上最年轻的门将。比利时人以 21 岁零 78 天的年龄首次在英格兰顶级联赛上场，超越兰尼·皮吉利，成为自 1992 年以来联赛中最年轻的门将。虽然潘德斯现在保持着蓝军英超联赛的纪录，但我们历史上最年轻的门将仍然是金斯利·惠芬。 1967 年，惠芬在一级联赛客场对阵莱斯特城的比赛中单独亮相时，年仅 16 岁零 157 天。紧随惠芬之后的是史蒂夫·弗朗西斯（17 岁零 130 天）和莱斯·弗里奇（17 岁零 251 天），他们是我们最年轻的门将。以下是彭德斯打破了保持了 20 多年的纪录后，英超时代为切尔西出场的五名最年轻门将的详细资料……周六，彭德斯在希尔迪金森体育场下半场替补出场，取代了受伤的马丁内斯。这位上赛季被租借到斯特拉斯堡的年轻比利时人在压力下表现出了极大的冷静。他在禁区边缘的一记极具统治力的一拳引人注目，帮助我们取得了自一月份以来的首场联赛不失球。查尔顿竞技队（主）——2005 年 5 月 7 日 学院毕业生皮吉利此前保持着英超联赛纪录。在 2004/05 赛季和 2005/06 赛季夺冠期间，皮吉利是我们的第三门将，仅次于伟大的切赫和库迪奇尼。在我们最终1-0战胜查尔顿的比赛中，穆里尼奥在我们首次捧起英超奖杯的那天，他为蓝军鞠了一躬。在接下来的一个赛季，他又打了一场比赛，然后转会到米尔沃尔。曼联（主）——2004 年 8 月 15 日 彼得·切赫 (Petr Cech) 在 2004/05 赛季的开幕日上演切尔西首秀时还不到 22 岁。他在斯坦福桥对阵曼联的比赛中保持不失球，为破纪录的赛季和职业生涯奠定了基调。切赫保持了英超历史上最多的不失球纪录，并在切尔西赢得了四次英超冠军、四次足总杯冠军，当然还有欧冠冠军。在马德里竞技队租借三年并取得成功后，蒂博·库尔图瓦回到斯坦福桥，并在 2014/15 赛季的首周末上演了他的英超首秀。这位身材高大的比利时人在那一年取代了切赫，帮助蓝军夺得了英超冠军。南安普顿 (客) – 2024 年 12 月 4 日 菲利普·乔根森 (Filip Jorgensen) 跻身前五。约根森于 2024 年夏天从比利亚雷亚尔签约，在周中战胜南安普顿的比赛中首次亮相英超联赛。他在我们那个赛季胜利的欧足联会议联赛中发挥了重要作用，并且还在世俱杯中出场，帮助我们捧起了更多的奖杯。 21 年 78 天 |埃弗顿 (客) (替补) | 17/10/2026 莱尼·皮吉利 | 21 岁 90 天 |查尔顿竞技 (主) (替补) | 07/05/2005 彼得·切赫 | 22 岁 87 天 |曼联 (主) | 15/08/2004 蒂博·库尔图瓦 | 22 岁 99 天 |伯恩利 (客) | 18/08/2014 菲利普·乔根森 | 22 年 232 天 |南安普顿 (客) | 2024年4月12日

news.title: PGA Division 1 report: Chelsea Women Under-18s 5-1 Tottenham Hotspur
news.title_zh: PGA Division 1 报告：切尔西 18 岁以下女子 5-1 托特纳姆热刺
news.body_en: Chelsea Women Under-18s, who play in the PGA Under-21 Women's League, began our Women’s PGA National League Division 1 campaign with a 5-1 victory over Tottenham Hotspur at Cobham, with Manaka Matsukubo scoring a hat-trick. Spurs took the lead with just 15 seconds on the clock, but Matsukubo levelled on eight minutes and Lola Brown struck twice before half-time to put the Blues in control. Matsukubo added two more after the break, completing her hat-trick with a superb volley on 70 minutes. First-team players Brown, Nelly Las, Chloe Sarwie and Matsukubo were all involved for Leanne Champ’s side. It was Brown’s third appearance for the Under-18s, while Las, Sarwie and Matsukubo each made their second appearance for the team this season. Spurs went ahead straight from kick-off. A long ball forward was not cleared by the Chelsea defence and midfield, and Nife Aramide collected on the edge of the area before finding the bottom corner. The early lead did not last long. Matsukubo was unable to convert at the end of a Rebekah Pierce cross, but Keira Johnson (pictured top) quickly won the ball back on the edge of the area and slid it through for Matsukubo, who calmly placed her finish past the onrushing Sophie Jackson. A rapid counter-attack put Chelsea ahead before the half-hour mark. Matsukubo cleared the ball from our own box and Chelsea N’Drin recovered it, allowing Brown to drive forward into the Spurs half. A well-timed one-two with Matsukubo took Brown into the box, where she cut onto her left foot and finished at the near post. Brown added a third as half-time approached. She pressed a Spurs goal-kick aggressively, intercepted a pass from the goalkeeper and quickly passed into a virtually empty net. Champ made three changes at the break, with Elise Christian, Stevie Sinclair and Jahmya Putman replacing Gabi Storey, Johnson and N’Drin. Sophie Leach came on for Sarwie on 61 minutes. The Blues scored a fourth on 63 minutes. Matsukubo found Pierce out wide on the left, and as Pierce drove inside she laid the ball off to Matsukubo on the overlap. Matsukubo jinked past three Spurs defenders in the box and bent her shot into the far corner. She saved the best for last seven minutes later. A headed clearance from a Chelsea corner fell to Matsukubo on the edge of the box, and she controlled it on her chest before chipping it past an onrushing defender, setting herself up for a left-footed volley into the far corner to make it 5-1. Chelsea have started our Division 1 campaign with a strong win and sit second in the table, behind the leaders only on goal difference. The Blues now have a two-week break before returning to Women’s National League Cup action on Sunday 1 November. We travel to Oxford United Women in the first knockout round, facing a side who are top of the third tier and unbeaten. news.body_zh: 参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛的切尔西 18 岁以下女子队在科巴姆以 5-1 战胜托特纳姆热刺队，开始了女子 PGA 国家联赛第 1 级的比赛，松久保爱中 (Manaka Matsukubo) 上演了帽子戏法。热刺在比赛还剩 15 秒时取得领先，但松久保在第 8 分钟扳平比分，洛拉·布朗在半场结束前梅开二度帮助蓝军掌控局势。中场休息后松久保再进两球，在第 70 分钟凭借一记精彩的抽射完成帽子戏法。一线队球员布朗、内莉·拉斯、克洛伊·萨尔维和松久保都参加了莉安·钱普的球队。这是布朗第三次代表U-18 队出场，而拉斯、萨尔维和松久保则是本赛季第二次代表球队出场。热刺一开球就直接领先。一名长传前锋没有被切尔西防守和中场解围，尼夫·阿拉米德在禁区边缘接球，然后找到底角。早期的领先优势并没有持续多久。丽贝卡·皮尔斯 (Rebekah Pierce) 传中后，松久保未能完成转换，但凯拉·约翰逊 (上图) 很快在禁区边缘夺回球权，并将球传给松久保，松久保冷静地将球射过冲上来的索菲·杰克逊 (Sophie Jackson)。半小时前，切尔西凭借快速反击取得领先。松久保将球从我们的禁区内解围，切尔西恩德林将球接回，让布朗带球进入热刺半场。布朗与松久保在一次恰到好处的二过一中将布朗带入禁区，她用左脚切入近门柱。半场结束时，布朗再进一球。她积极地逼抢热刺球门球，拦截守门员的传球，并迅速将球传入几乎空门。中场休息时，钱普做出了三项调整，埃莉斯·克里斯蒂安、史蒂夫·辛克莱和贾米亚·普特曼取代了加比·斯托里、约翰逊和恩德林。第 61 分钟，索菲·利奇 (Sophie Leach) 替下萨尔维 (Sarwie)。蓝军在第 63 分钟取得第四球。松久保在左侧找到了皮尔斯，当皮尔斯突破内线时，她将球传给了重叠处的松久保。松久保在禁区内突破了三名热刺后卫，将射门射入远角。她在最后七分钟后保存了最好的成绩。切尔西角球中的头球解围落在禁区边缘的松久保身上，她将球控制在胸前，然后将球越过冲上来的后卫，左脚抽射入远角，将比分改写为5-1。切尔西以一场强劲的胜利开始了我们的一级联赛，目前在积分榜上排名第二，仅以净胜球之差落后于领头羊。蓝军现在有两周的休息时间，然后才能在 11 月 1 日星期日重返女子全国联赛杯比赛。我们将在第一轮淘汰赛中对阵牛津联女足，对手是一支第三梯队的顶级球队且保持不败。切尔西（3-4-3）：维多利亚·鲁兹； Gabi Storey（Elise Christian 45）、Sadie Gregory、Chloe Sarwie（Sophie Leach 61）； Nelly Las、Keira Johnson（Stevie Sinclair 45）、Belle Sullivan、Rebekah Pierce； Manaka Matsukubo (Zoe Ciccardini 75)、Lola Brown、Chelsea N’Drin (Jahm​​ya Putman 45)得分手：Matsukubo 8、63、70、Brown 28、40经理：Leanne Champ

news.title: Rachael Adedini signs first professional contract with Chelsea
news.title_zh: 雷切尔·阿德迪尼 (Rachael Adedini) 与切尔西签订第一份职业合同
news.body_en: Chelsea can confirm that promising young forward Rachael Adedini has signed her first contract as a professional with the club. A dynamic and versatile forward, Adedini is a central striker, and can also play out wide. The 17-year-old has represented France Under-17s on 24 occasions and has played at Under-19 level twice. On putting pen to paper on her first professional deal, Adedini said: ‘I'm very happy to be here. I'm excited, and I'm grateful to be here. ‘I'm thankful to God, and the reason behind this is because my brother's a big fan, and we've always loved Chelsea, so playing here today is a massive pride for me and my family.’ The young forward was born in Le Havre in France. She has played at three consecutive Women’s Under-17 European Championships since the 2023/24 campaign and has stood out with nine goals in total. That strike rate has seen her equal Germany’s Shekiera Martinez as the all-time top scorer at the Women's Under-17 Euros. France made the final in 2026, narrowly losing to Germany with a 1-0 defeat. Adedini finished the tournament with the Golden Boot award after scoring in a 5-0 win over Poland and netting a brace in a 4-1 victory over Finland in the group stages. Everyone at Chelsea extends a warm welcome to Rachael, and we look forward to watching her progress.
news.body_zh: 切尔西可以确认，有前途的年轻前锋雷切尔·阿德迪尼已经与俱乐部签署了她作为职业球员的第一份合同。阿德迪尼是一名充满活力、多才多艺的前锋，是一名中锋，也可以踢边路。这位 17 岁的球员曾 24 次代表法国 U-17 队参赛，并两次参加过 U-19 级别比赛。在签署她的第一份职业合同时，阿德迪尼说：“我很高兴来到这里。我很兴奋，也很感激来到这里。 “我感谢上帝，这背后的原因是因为我哥哥是切尔西的忠实粉丝，而且我们一直都很喜欢切尔西，所以今天在这里比赛对我和我的家人来说是一个巨大的骄傲。”这位年轻的前锋出生在法国勒阿弗尔。自2023/24赛季以来，她已连续三届参加女子17岁以下欧洲锦标赛，并总共打入9粒进球，脱颖而出。这一进球率使她追平了德国选手谢基拉·马丁内斯 (Shekiera Martinez)，成为女子 17 岁以下欧洲杯历史最佳射手。法国队在2026年打进决赛，以0比1险胜德国队。阿德迪尼在小组赛5-0战胜波兰的比赛中梅开二度，并在4-1战胜芬兰的比赛中梅开二度，获得了本届世界杯的金靴奖。切尔西的每个人都热烈欢迎瑞秋，我们期待看到她的进步。

news.title: George Weah recalls his ‘historic’ debut derby winner against Tottenham
news.title_zh: 乔治·维阿回忆起他对阵托特纳姆热刺的“历史性”德比首秀
news.body_en: All Chelsea eyes are looking ahead to Saturday’s derby with Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge. In the corresponding fixture just over a quarter-of-a-century ago, George Weah lit up a cold winter’s night by heading his name into Blues folklore with the winning goal on his debut. The megastar striker’s stay in west London wasn’t a long one, but he knew how to make an impression. There was a tangible sense of bristling excitement inside Stamford Bridge as Weah made his way to the touchline to prepare for his Chelsea debut early in the second half of a feisty league game against Tottenham in January 2000. The 1995 Ballon d’Or winner had only flown into London a few hours earlier, signing the relevant paperwork on a loan deal from AC Milan before making his way to the ground, where he was immediately named as a substitute by Blues boss Gianluca Vialli. Now, he was preparing to make his debut in the 56th minute of a floodlit London derby. The Liberian striker was one of the biggest names in world football at the time. He had been one of Milan’s star turns at a time when Serie A was the strongest league in Europe, and everyone had seen his famous goal against Verona in 1996, when he had picked up the ball inside his own box then proceeded to run the length of the pitch before guiding the ball into the far corner. However, the 33-year-old had fallen out of favour at the San Siro by the midway point of the 1999/2000 season and Chelsea – who had topped the UEFA Champions League group that Milan had propped up earlier that season – reacted quickest to the news that he might be available. Vialli wasted no time in putting him in the team, either, and when he emerged from the bench wearing Chelsea blue for the first time, Weah’s mere presence triggered an audible buzz, which broke into a monumental cheer as the world-famous striker entered the fray. Half-an-hour later, he was celebrating the winning goal – the only goal of the game – three minutes from time, in front of the Shed End. His powerful leap at the back post had taken him a full foot higher than Stephens Carr and Clemence, who floundered as Weah headed Dennis Wise’s cross past Ian Walker. His eyes wide with delight under the floodlights, Weah’s celebrations dominated the back pages the following morning. ‘Weah on the march with Luca’s army!’ read the headline on the inside back page of the Daily Mirror, punning on defeated Spurs’ famous FA Cup final song, while the looks of delight on the faces of his team-mates Jon Harley and Chris Sutton seemed to be derived almost as much from the presence of Weah in their midst as from the delirium of a late victory over our London rivals. He reflected on that moment a decade later in an interview for our official website. ‘My time with Chelsea was excellent – I came in for half a season and in the most important game, the first game, Chelsea won and I scored,’ recalled Weah. ‘It’s historical for me, it will forever remain in my mind and my heart, it was the day I came to Chelsea and I scored.’ Back-to-back draws in their previous two games had left Vialli with the feeling that he needed another option up front. The partnership of Tore Andre Flo and Gianfranco Zola was suffering a mid-season crisis of confidence, while big-money summer signing Sutton had failed to settle in. Weah’s arrival changed that, as Vialli decided to partner the Liberian with Sutton, viewing the physically imposing duo as an alternative double act to Zola and Flo. Sutton relished the chance to link up with the new arrival and teed up Weah for the second goal in our 2-1 win over Leicester City in the FA Cup fifth round. Up against a physical side, Vialli went for the lesser-spotted large and large partnership up top, and Sutton sent his man sprawling to the floor before pulling the ball back for Weah to sweep home across the goalkeeper. These days, Sutton’s rough stuff would almost certainly have been penalised by the officials, or their video assistants, but the goal stood and the Blues progressed past Martin O’Neill’s towering side after matching them for aggression and spirit. In the following round, against Gillingham at Stamford Bridge, Weah produced a moment of magic that drew gasps from the stands, casually leaning forward in the centre circle in anticipation of a dropping ball and flicking a volleyed pass over his head with his heel. The audacious pass found its mark and it was the highlight of a 5-0 win, in which Weah also registered his third goal for the club. In total, he struck five times in 15 games for the Blues and signed off with an FA Cup winner’s medal after starting in our 1-0 win over Aston Villa in the 2000 final. The striker bounced around the old Wembley pitch following the last-ever cup final under those famous twin towers wearing a vest with a specially printed message for his son. ‘I believe in God, Timothy,’ it read. ‘I won the last FA Cup at Wembley before it was destroyed and that was a big impact for me, it is history for me,’ the legendary striker said of that day. ‘The FA Cup is one of the best competitions in the world and is a huge part of the English culture. ‘It is what I used to watch on television and then I was part of it, so again I have to thank all of the people that made it possible: Vialli, Zola, Dennis Wise, Chris Sutton, all those guys who wanted me to be successful and made me comfortable.’ After retiring from club football in 2003, Weah became involved in politics and was elected President of Liberia in 2017. Timothy – the subject of his inspirational printed message at Wembley in 2000 – has gone on to become a professional footballer himself, playing internationally for the USA, where he was born and raised, at the FIFA World Cup in 2022 and 2026. He also made an appearance against Chelsea during the 2021/22 season, when he came on as substitute for Lille in the first leg of our Champions League last-16 tie. A generation later, many a Blues fan raised a smile as the sight of the name ‘Weah’ on the team-sheet brought back found memories of derby victory at the Bridge. - A version of this article first appeared in the matchday programme in 2022. news.body_zh: 所有切尔西的目光都在期待周六在斯坦福桥与托特纳姆热刺队的德比。在四分之一个多世纪前的相应比赛中，乔治·维阿在首秀中攻入制胜一球，让自己的名字载入了蓝军民间传说，照亮了寒冷的冬夜。这位巨星前锋在伦敦西部停留的时间并不长，但他知道如何给人留下深刻的印象。 2000 年 1 月，在一场激烈的联赛对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛中，下半场一开始，维阿就走向了边线，准备在切尔西的首秀，斯坦福桥内弥漫着一种明显的兴奋感。 这位 1995 年金球奖得主几个小时前才飞抵伦敦，签署了 AC 米兰租借协议的相关文件，然后才抵达球场，在那里他立即被蓝军主帅吉安卢卡任命为替补。维亚利.现在，他正准备在灯光伦敦德比的第56分钟首次亮相。这位利比里亚前锋是当时世界足坛最知名的球员之一。当意甲是欧洲最强联赛时，他是米兰的明星球员之一，每个人都看过他在1996年对阵维罗纳的著名进球，当时他在自己的禁区里接球，然后跑过球场，然后将球带入远角。然而，这位33岁的球员在1999/2000赛季中期就在圣西罗失宠了，而切尔西——当时米兰在该赛季早些时候支持的欧冠联赛小组第一——对他可能上场的消息反应最快。维亚利也毫不犹豫地将他纳入球队，当他第一次穿着切尔西蓝球衣从替补席上出现时，维阿的出现就引发了一阵嗡嗡声，当这位世界著名前锋加入战斗时，现场爆发出巨大的欢呼声。半小时后，距离比赛结束还有三分钟，他在谢德恩德球场前庆祝制胜进球——全场唯一进球。他在后门柱上的有力跳跃使他比斯蒂芬斯·卡尔和克莱门斯高出了整整一英尺，当维阿头球攻过丹尼斯·怀斯的传中越过伊恩·沃克时，克莱门斯陷入了困境。维阿在泛光灯下睁大了眼睛，充满喜悦，第二天早上，维阿的庆祝活动占据了最后几页。 《每日镜报》内封页的标题是“维阿与卢卡的军队一起进军！”，双关语是击败热刺队著名的足总杯决赛歌曲，而他的队友乔恩·哈雷和克里斯·萨顿脸上的喜悦表情似乎既来自维阿在他们中间的存在，又来自我们最后战胜伦敦对手的狂喜。十年后，他在我们官方网站的采访中回顾了那一刻。 “我在切尔西的时光非常美好——我效力了半个赛季，在最重要的比赛，第一场比赛中，切尔西赢了，我进球了，”维阿回忆道。 “这对我来说是历史性的，它将永远留在我的脑海和心里，那是我来到切尔西并进球的那一天。”前两场比赛的背靠背平局让维亚利感觉他需要在锋线上另一个选择。托雷·安德烈·弗洛和吉安弗兰科·佐拉的搭档在赛季中期遭遇了信任危机，而夏天斥巨资签下的萨顿却未能安定下来。维阿的到来改变了这一点，维亚利决定让利比里亚人与萨顿搭档，将这对身体强壮的二人组视为佐拉和弗洛的替代双人组合。萨顿很享受与新援联手的机会，并在足总杯第五轮2-1战胜莱斯特城的比赛中为维阿打进了第二个进球。面对实力强劲的球队，维亚利选择了上场的大号搭档，萨顿将他的防守球员打倒在地，然后将球拉回给维阿，后者将球横过门将。如今，萨顿的粗鲁行为几乎肯定会受到裁判或他们的视频助理的处罚，但进球有效，蓝军在与马丁·奥尼尔的进攻和精神相匹配后，超越了马丁·奥尼尔的高大球队。在接下来的一轮中，在斯坦福桥对阵吉林汉姆的比赛中，维阿创造了一个神奇的时刻，让看台上的人都倒吸一口冷气，他在中圈随意地向前倾身，等待着球的落下，然后用脚后跟将一记凌空传球从头顶上弹过。 这记大胆的传球达到了目的，成为5-0获胜的亮点，维阿也为俱乐部打进了他的第三个进球。总共，他在为蓝军出战的 15 场比赛中攻入 5 球，并在 2000 年决赛 1-0 战胜阿斯顿维拉的比赛中首发出场，并获得了足总杯冠军奖牌。在著名的双子塔下举行的最后一场杯赛决赛结束后，这位前锋在旧温布利球场上跳跃，穿着一件背心，上面专门印有给他儿子的信息。 “我相信上帝，蒂莫西，”上面写着。 “我在温布利球场被毁之前赢得了上届足总杯冠军，这对我影响很大，对我来说这是历史，”这位传奇前锋谈到那天时说道。 “足总杯是世界上最好的赛事之一，也是英国文化的重要组成部分。 “这是我以前在电视上看到的，然后我就成为了其中的一部分，所以我要再次感谢所有让这一切成为可能的人：维亚利、佐拉、丹尼斯·怀斯、克里斯·萨顿，所有那些希望我成功并让我感到舒适的人。”2003年从俱乐部足球退役后，维阿开始涉足政治，并于2017年当选利比里亚总统。蒂莫西——他在温布利的鼓舞人心的印刷信息的主题2000 年，他自己也成为了一名职业足球运动员，在 2022 年和 2026 年的 FIFA 世界杯上为他出生和长大的美国队效力。他还在 2021/22 赛季对阵切尔西的比赛中出场，当时他在欧冠 16 强首回合比赛中替补里尔出场。一代人之后，当许多蓝军球迷看到球队名单上的“维阿”名字时，他们都露出了微笑，唤起了人们对蓝桥德比胜利的回忆。 - news.title: Analysis: How Chelsea's persistence paid off against Tottenham
news.title_zh: 分析：切尔西的坚持如何在对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛中得到回报
news.body_en: Chelsea Women had never lost to Tottenham in any competition before Sunday's clash at Stamford Bridge. But that didn't mean it would be easy to record our 19th consecutive win against them. Despite what the 6-2 scoreline might suggest, it was far from straightforward. Their head coach Martin Ho had steered them into fourth position in the Women's Super League table before the match kicked off, and it was soon clear they were more resilient than before. Battling for every ball, Spurs kept around 50 per cent possession in the first half, and went in at the break with the scores even at 1-1. The Blues found another gear once the hour mark had passed and put the game out of sight, but an improved Tottenham had certainly made things difficult up to that point. Here's a look at how we secured the three points... Tottenham approached the match looking determined to break a run of 19 defeats against cross-city rivals Chelsea. A look at the stats showed they matched us in a number of areas, with seven shots on target to our eight, and 94 passes in the final third as opposed to our tally of 107. And while other teams sit in a low block against us, Spurs deserve credit for trying to secure a win at Stamford Bridge, even though they ultimately came up short of their objective. The momentum graph above indicates how they enjoyed sustained periods of pressure: in the opening minutes of the match, between the half-hour mark and half-time, and straight from the kick-off after the break. But when Sonia Bompastor made a triple change on the hour mark, Chelsea's strength in depth really shone through. Sjoeke Nusken and Maika Hamano scored our fourth and fifth goals of the afternoon not long after coming off the bench. We killed the game off in a matter of minutes, but the encounter was much more evenly matched until those aforementioned substitutions. Katie McCabe, like many others in the side, came into Sunday's match having represented her country during the international window. The Republic of Ireland captain helped them defeat Kazakhstan 12-0 on aggregate in a Women's World Cup qualifier, playing the 90 minutes and scoring in the 4-0 second-leg success in Cork last Tuesday. McCabe ranked highest of the Blues in terms of chances created (four) and crosses attempted (five). She also completed the second-highest number of passes (38) and ranked fifth in completed passes in the final third (seven). When the team scores six goals, performances like McCabe's can go under the radar, but she made a significant contribution to our success on Sunday. Playing just 68 minutes before being replaced by Nathalie Bjorn, Lucy Bronze put in another impressive performance in the heart of the defence on Sunday. Registering the assist for Lauren James' second strike of the afternoon, the Chelsea vice-captain made the most ball recoveries of any outfield player (eight), won the most tackles (five), and completed the most passes (40). Another player whose contribution may have been slightly overlooked in favour of the goalscorers at the Bridge on Sunday, but her touch map alone shows how much ground she covered, even though she was substituted with 20 minutes still to play. The Chelsea fans at Stamford Bridge were treated to another Lauren James show on Sunday, as she left them open-mouthed with her audacious strike from the byline in the first half. She then went for goal in a fashion that most other players would not consider, netting her second while leaning at an angle with a defender on her tail. Head coach Sonia Bompastor described her as a 'world-class player' in her post-match press conference, and it's not difficult to see why. Scoring a brace from only three shots on goal, her quality ensured we took the lead when the contest was extremely tight in the first half. Her two goals came from an xG (expected goals) rating of just 0.76, which shows just how difficult her chances were to convert. 'It's a big help when you have a player who can create from nothing,' said Bompastor afterwards. 'I want to also highlight the team performance. When individuals are performing, it's usually because the team is performing as well. The players around her are doing a job for her to express her quality on the ball.'
news.body_zh: 在周日斯坦福桥比赛之前，切尔西女足从未在任何比赛中输给过热刺。但这并不意味着我们能轻松取得对他们的第 19 场连胜。尽管 6-2 的比分暗示了这一点，但事情远非那么简单。比赛开始前，她们的主教练何马丁就带领她们在女超联赛积分榜上排名第四，很快我们就发现她们比以前更有韧性了。热刺在上半场每球必争，控球率保持在 50% 左右，中场休息时将比分扳成 1-1 平。一小时过去后，蓝军找到了另一个装备，让比赛消失了，但进步的托特纳姆热刺无疑让事情变得困难。让我们来看看我们是如何拿下三分的……托特纳姆热刺在比赛临近时看起来决心打破同城对手切尔西队的 19 场连败。统计数据显示，他们在很多方面都与我们旗鼓相当，射门次数为 7 次，我们为 8 次，最后三区传球次数为 94 次，而我们的传球次数为 107 次。虽然其他球队在对阵我们时处于低位，但热刺队在斯坦福桥的比赛中努力取得胜利，值得赞扬，尽管他们最终未能实现目标。上面的动量图显示了他们如何享受持续的压力：在比赛的开始几分钟，半小时到半场之间，以及中场休息后直接开球。但当索尼娅·邦帕斯特在比赛进行到一个小时时做出三次换人时，切尔西的板凳深度实力才真正显现出来。 Sjoeke Nusken 和 Maika Hamano 在替补上场后不久就攻入了我们下午的第四个和第五个进球。我们在几分钟之内就结束了比赛，但在上述的换人之前，比赛的双方势均力敌。凯蒂·麦凯布和其他许多人一样，在国际比赛期间代表国家队参加了周日的比赛。这位爱尔兰共和国队长帮助球队在女足世界杯预选赛中以总比分 12-0 击败哈萨克斯坦队，上周二在科克举行的次回合比赛中，她踢满了 90 分钟并进球，帮助球队以 4-0 获胜。麦凯布在创造机会（四次）和传中尝试（五次）方面名列蓝军最高。她还完成了第二高的传球次数（38次），并在最后三分之一的传球成功次数中排名第五（7次）。当球队打进六个球时，像麦凯布这样的表现可能会受到关注，但她为我们周日的成功做出了重大贡献。周日，露西·布朗泽在后防线核心位置上的表现再次令人印象深刻，她在上场仅 68 分钟就被纳塔莉·比约恩换下。这位切尔西副队长为劳伦·詹姆斯（Lauren James）下午的第二次进球送出助攻，这位切尔西副队长是所有外场球员中接球次数最多的（8次）、赢得最多铲球（5次）和完成最多传球（40次）的球员。周日，另一名球员的贡献可能被桥上的进球者所忽视，但仅凭她的触球图就可以看出她覆盖了多少场地，尽管她在比赛还剩 20 分钟时被换下。周日，斯坦福桥的切尔西球迷又欣赏了劳伦·詹姆斯的另一场表演，她在上半场边线的大胆进球让他们目瞪口呆。然后，她以大多数其他球员不会考虑的方式射门，在后卫尾随的情况下以一定角度倾斜，攻入第二球。主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯托在赛后新闻发布会上将她描述为“世界级球员”，原因不难理解。她仅三脚射门就梅开二度，她的出色表现确保了我们在上半场比赛异常胶着的情况下取得了领先。她的两个进球来自于仅为 0.76 的 xG（预期进球）评分，这表明她转化的机会有多么困难。 “当你拥有一名能够从无到有创造的球员时，这是一个很大的帮助，”邦帕斯特事后说道。 “我还想强调球队的表现。当个人表现出色时，通常是因为团队也在表现出色。她周围的球员正在为她做一份工作，让她展现她的球技。”

news.title: Analysis: Collective resilience and decisive Neto pivotal to Everton win
news.title_zh: 分析：集体韧性和果断的内托对埃弗顿获胜至关重要
news.body_en: Saturday’s win at Everton included a first clean sheet in the Premier League since January, a star performance from Pedro Neto, and yet another goal scored early on in a half. Here we dissect some of the key elements behind a super success on Merseyside using statistics to come out of our maiden win at the Hill Dickinson Stadium. Xabi Alonso spoke in the build-up about the significance of matching Everton’s tenacious approach. It was something we managed to do for only 45 minutes at Brentford, and our manager said his team had learned from that disappointing second half at the Gtech Stadium in our last away game. Those learnings were clear to see as we went toe to toe with the Toffees physically. In what was a feisty first half, with five yellow cards shown before the 35th minute, we won six tackles to Everton’s four and came out on top in nine of the 10 aerial duels. By the final whistle, we had won more tackles, made more interceptions and fared better in the aerial and ground duels contested. We also ran further than Everton (114 kilometres to 111km) over the 115 minutes the contest ran to. Those successes helped us stymie Everton’s attack throughout. We limited our hosts to six shots, their fewest in a league game this season. Their total xG (expected goals) was 0.43, of which just 0.13 stemmed from open-play attempts. It was the first time since February they failed to score in a home game. While Everton completed more passes than us in the final third, our defensive fortitude and astute positioning ensured they were largely kept well away from our goal. We regularly forced them wide, from where we were able to deal with the 20 crosses they sent into our box. We thoroughly deserved a first league away clean sheet since last December and, as Alonso noted afterwards, it was the collective efforts of his side that earned it. Nobody epitomised that more than Pedro Neto. Of course, his first-ever Premier League brace stole the headlines and secured us the points, but the Portuguese showed his value defensively, too. He regained possession on five occasions – a figure only bettered by Morgan Rogers – and also won a joint-high three tackles. Alonso seemed surprised when a journalist described Neto as a wing-back after the match, with our manager preferring to label him as an attacker ‘who can do many things’. In the first half at Everton, Neto forced Jordan Pickford into a fingertip save with an effort from distance. After the break, he scored twice with precise left-footed shots, having manoeuvred himself into dangerous positions in the penalty box. Those three attempts amounted to just 0.37 xG, testament to the quality of his finishing. He also created a game-high five chances for his team-mates (his most since April 2025), and recorded a passing accuracy of 100 per cent in the final third – that despite only two Blues playing more passes in that area of the pitch. It has been a strong start to the season for Neto, with only eight players in the league having scored more goals than his three. He also ranks highly for take-ons, drives into the box and chances created. Allied to his defensive worth, it is obvious why Alonso is so happy to have him on our right flank. Neto’s first of the afternoon arrived just 43 seconds after the interval, continuing our remarkable record of scoring early in halves this season. We have now netted three times in the opening minute of a half (Joao Pedro vs Fulham and Bournemouth, Neto vs Everton) – already our joint-most in a Premier League season, along with 2011/12. We became the third team in Premier League history, and first since its inaugural season, to score in the opening minute of the second half in consecutive games. Eight of our 17 league goals this season have arrived in the opening four minutes of a half, and our nine scored in the first 10 minutes is the most any team has mustered in Premier League history after seven matches. It is certainly a useful habit to have – and if you’re coming to Saturday’s game against Tottenham, make sure you’re in your seat for the start of each half!
news.body_zh: 周六对阵埃弗顿的胜利包括自一月份以来英超联赛的首次零失球、佩德罗·内托的明星表现以及半场初期的另一个进球。在这里，我们使用统计数据剖析了默西塞德郡取得超级成功背后的一些关键因素，这些数据来自我们在希尔迪金森体育场的首次胜利。哈维·阿隆索在比赛准备中谈到了与埃弗顿顽强的比赛相媲美的重要性。我们在布伦特福德只花了 45 分钟就做到了这一点，我们的主教练说他的球队已经从上一场客场比赛中 Gtech 体育场令人失望的下半场吸取了教训。当我们与太妃糖队进行身体对抗时，这些教训就显而易见了。在激烈的上半场比赛中，我们在第 35 分钟前出示了 5 张黄牌，但我们在埃弗顿的 4 次铲断中赢得了 6 次铲球，并在 10 次空中对抗中取得了 9 次胜利。到终场哨响时，我们赢得了更多的铲断，更多的拦截，并且在空中和地面对抗中表现更好。在比赛进行的 115 分钟内，我们比埃弗顿跑得更远（114 公里到 111 公里）。这些成功帮助我们自始至终阻碍了埃弗顿的进攻。我们将东道主的射门次数限制在六次，这是他们本赛季联赛中最少的一次。他们的总 xG（预期进球）为 0.43，其中只有 0.13 来自开放比赛尝试。这是自二月份以来他们第一次在主场比赛中未能进球。虽然埃弗顿在最后三分之一的传球次数比我们多，但我们的防守坚韧和精明的站位确保他们基本上远离我们的球门。我们经常把他们逼到边路，这样我们就能够应对他们送入我们禁区的 20 个传中。自去年12月以来，我们完全配得上首次联赛客场不失球，正如阿隆索事后指出的那样，这是他球队的集体努力赢得的。没有人比佩德罗·内托更能体现这一点。当然，他在英超联赛中的首个梅开二度占据了头条新闻并为我们确保了积分，但葡萄牙人在防守上也展示了他的价值。他五次重新获得控球权——这一数字仅次于摩根·罗杰斯——并且还赢得了并列最高的三次铲断。赛后，当一名记者将内托描述为一名边后卫时，阿隆索显得很惊讶，而我们的主教练更愿意将他贴上“能做很多事情”的攻击手的标签。在对阵埃弗顿的上半场，内托的远射迫使乔丹·皮克福德用指尖扑出。中场休息后，他在禁区内进入危险位置，用精准的左脚射门梅开二度。这 3 次尝试总计仅为 0.37 xG，证明了他的射门质量。他还为队友创造了全场最高的五次机会（这是自 2025 年 4 月以来的最多机会），并在进攻三分之一区传球准确率达到 100%——尽管只有两名蓝军在该区域传球次数更多。对于内托来说，这是一个强劲的赛季开局，联盟中只有八名球员的进球数比他的三名球员多。他在抢断、突破禁区和创造机会方面也名列前茅。与他的防守价值相结合，很明显为什么阿隆索如此高兴让他出现在我们的右翼。内托下午的第一个进球在中场休息后仅 43 秒到来，延续了我们本赛季半场初期进球的非凡记录。我们现在在半场开场一分钟内就进了三个球（若昂·佩德罗对阵富勒姆和伯恩茅斯，内托对阵埃弗顿）——这已经是我们英超联赛赛季中进球最多的球队，与2011/12赛季并列。我们成为英超历史上第三支连续比赛在下半场开场一分钟进球的球队，也是自其创始赛季以来第一支球队。本赛季我们的17个联赛进球中有8个是在半场开场4分钟内打进的，而我们在前10分钟内打进的9个进球是英超历史上七场比赛后进球最多的球队。这当然是一个有用的习惯——如果您要观看周六对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛，请确保在每半场开始时您都坐在自己的座位上！

news.title: Ellie Carpenter on Chelsea's 'new era' after big win over Tottenham
news.title_zh: 埃莉·卡彭特谈切尔西大胜托特纳姆热刺后的“新时代”
news.body_en: Ellie Carpenter hailed a new-look Chelsea side after she scored a brace in a resounding 6-2 win over Tottenham at Stamford Bridge on Sunday. The Blues have netted 25 goals in our unbeaten start to the season, winning eight out of our ten matches. Carpenter has featured in all ten games and has three goals and three assists to her name. The right wing-back arrived from Lyon at the beginning of last season and can see the difference in the team’s performances this time around. ‘I would say it's like a new Chelsea,’ she said after Sunday's victory. ‘We're creating our own legacy, our own type of season this year. We're the 2026/27 Chelsea. ‘It's a new era, and this season we are really working collectively; everyone is together, and we’re taking things game by game. We don't want to look too far ahead of ourselves. We’ll just continue to try and put in the good performances.’ Chelsea had 20 players away on international duty across the world last week, returning only two days before we faced Tottenham in Women’s Super League action. Head coach Sonia Bompastor described the biggest challenge she faced during that period as ‘reconnecting quickly with the game model.' For that reason alone, Carpenter was proud of how the team responded to the challenge after a tough first half in which we went in all square at 1-1 at the interval. ‘It was a real team performance, especially after the international break,’ she explained. ‘Sometimes it can take a little bit to get going as a team. ‘But we had a lot of different goalscorers, and the impact off the bench was great. I was very happy to score. I have been working a lot in the final third this season, so I’m very happy to contribute to the win.’ Also netting a brace on Sunday was Lauren James, who scored from the tightest of angles and converted another difficult chance in the second half. Carpenter paid tribute to her talented team-mate and explained why she loves being on the same team as the Chelsea number ten. ‘Yeah, she's amazing,’ the Australian said. ‘Incredible footballer. I love watching her play when I'm on the pitch. She makes it look so easy; she's so talented, and I’m so happy she's a Blue.’
news.body_zh: 埃莉·卡彭特周日在斯坦福桥以 6-2 大胜托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中梅开二度，对这支焕然一新的切尔西队表示欢迎。蓝军在本赛季不败的开局中打进了 25 个进球，赢得了 10 场比赛中的 8 场。卡彭特参加了所有十场比赛，并贡献了 3 个进球和 3 次助攻。这位右翼卫是上赛季初从里昂加盟的，这次可以看到球队表现的不同。 “我想说这就像一个新的切尔西，”她在周日的胜利后说道。 “我们正在创造我们自己的遗产，今年我们自己的赛季类型。我们是 2026/27 赛季的切尔西。 “这是一个新时代，这个赛季我们真正在共同努力；每个人都在一起，我们正在一场一场地比赛。我们不想看得太远。我们将继续努力，拿出好的表现。”上周，切尔西有 20 名球员在世界各地参加国际比赛，就在我们在女足超级联赛对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛前两天回归。主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特（Sonia Bompastor）形容她在那段时间面临的最大挑战是“快速重新融入游戏模式”。仅出于这个原因，卡彭特就为球队在经历了艰难的上半场后如何应对挑战而感到自豪，在上半场我们在中场休息时以 1-1 的比分打成平局。 “这是一场真正的团队表演，尤其是在国际比赛日之后，”她解释道。 “有时，作为一个团队可能需要一点时间才能开始。 “但是我们有很多不同的射手，替补席上的影响力很大。我很高兴能够进球。本赛季我在进攻区付出了很多努力，所以我很高兴能为这场胜利做出贡献。”周日同样梅开二度的还有劳伦·詹姆斯，他从最狭窄的角度得分，并在下半场再次获得了一次艰难的机会。卡彭特向她才华横溢的队友致敬，并解释了为什么她喜欢与切尔西十号球员在同一支球队。 “是的，她太棒了，”澳大利亚人说。 “令人难以置信的足球运动员。当我在球场上时，我喜欢看她踢球。她让它看起来很容易；她很有才华，我很高兴她是蓝色的。”

news.title: Four Chelsea December fixtures moved for TV
news.title_zh: 切尔西 12 月的四场比赛转为电视转播
news.body_en: Chelsea’s Premier League schedule in December has been confirmed with four more of our fixtures to be broadcast live on television. The dates and times of our away games after Christmas against Coventry City (Sunday 27 December, 2pm) and Ipswich Town (Wednesday 30 December, 8.15pm) had already been announced, and now we can bring you details of the rest of our fixture list in the final month of 2026. December begins with a home game against Crystal Palace. We will host the Eagles on Wednesday 2 December, with kick-off at Stamford Bridge now at 7.30pm. The game will be live on Sky Sports. Soon after, Liverpool come to the Bridge. That game remains on Saturday 5 December, but kick-off has been brought forward to 12.30pm with TNT Sports providing live coverage. The following weekend, we travel to the Etihad Stadium to play Manchester City. That game is on Saturday 12 December with kick-off at 5.30pm. Sky Sports are the broadcasters. Our final fixture before Christmas is against Aston Villa at Stamford Bridge, and it will now take place on Monday 21 December. Kick-off is at 8pm and Sky Sports are providing live coverage. Please note, that game with Aston Villa is subject to possible movement back to Saturday 19 December at 8pm, dependent upon Carabao Cup participation. Chelsea vs Crystal Palace – Wednesday 2 December, 7.30pm Chelsea vs Liverpool – Saturday 5 December, 12.30pm Manchester City vs Chelsea – Saturday 12 December, 5.30pm Chelsea vs Aston Villa – Monday 21 December, 8pm (subject to possible movement) Coventry City vs Chelsea – Sunday 27 December, 2pm Ipswich Town vs Chelsea – Wednesday 30 December, 8.15pm With our December schedule confirmed, now is the perfect time to secure your VIP place at Stamford Bridge this festive season. news.title: Ticket forwarding open for Tottenham match
news.title_zh: 托特纳姆热刺队比赛门票转发开放
news.body_en: We can confirm to supporters that ticket forwarding is now open for the next match at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea play at home to Tottenham Hotspur in the Premier League on Saturday (24 October). Please read the following if you would like to forward your ticket to other members. Ticket forwarding for this match is now open and will close at 2.30pm on Saturday. All non-accepted tickets will be returned to the original ticket holder. We wish to take this opportunity to remind anyone attending a game at Stamford Bridge that all tickets sold for the home areas are to be used by fans of Chelsea Football Club only. They are not for use by the supporters of any opposing team. This applies to hospitality and general admission areas, and to all season tickets and individual match tickets. Anyone who is found to have transferred a ticket for use by a supporter of an opposition team will face sanctions such as a ban from attending all Chelsea matches and the potential loss of a season ticket. news.title: Forward voted as your Star of the Match against Tottenham!
news.title_zh: 前锋被评选为对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛之星！
news.body_en: Chelsea Women entertained the crowds at Stamford Bridge with a 6-2 victory over Tottenham on Sunday, and Blues fans have voted for their standout performer. The teams went in at the break with the scores locked at 1-1, as Lauren James' audacious opener from the dead-ball line was cancelled out by Matilda Vinberg's 41st-minute effort. But in the second half, the Blues went on a goalscoring spree as Ellie Carpenter put us back in front with an emphatic finish at the far post before James showed her skill once more with another sublime goal just after the hour mark. The second-half substitutes then weighed in, with Sjoeke Nusken smashing home our fourth, before a superb swerving long-range strike from Maika Hamano put us 5-1 in front. Carpenter then completed the rout with a fantastic turn and finish, sealing the 6-2 victory. And it is James who has been voted as your Star of the Match on the Chelsea Official App, earning a whopping 69 per cent share of the votes after head coach Sonia Bompastor described our number ten as a 'world-class player' in her post-match press conference. Coming in second place with 24 per cent of the votes was Ellie Carpenter, who also netted a brace from her position at right wing-back.
news.body_zh: 周日，切尔西女足在斯坦福桥以 6-2 战胜托特纳姆热刺队，为观众带来了欢乐，蓝军球迷投票选出了她们表现出色的球员。两队在中场休息时将比分锁定为 1-1，劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 在死球线上大胆的首开纪录被玛蒂尔达·文伯格 (Matilda Vinberg) 在第 41 分钟的射门所抵消。但在下半场，蓝军继续疯狂进球，埃莉·卡彭特在远门柱大力射门，让我们重新领先，而詹姆斯在一个小时后再次展示了她的技巧，打进了另一个精彩的进球。下半场替补球员也发挥了作用，Sjoeke Nusken 打进了我们的第四球，随后滨野麦卡 (Maika Hamano) 的一脚漂亮的远射帮助我们以 5-1 领先。卡彭特随后以精彩的转身和终结完成了击溃，最终以 6-2 锁定胜局。在主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特在赛后新闻发布会上将我们的十号球员描述为“世界级球员”之后，詹姆斯在切尔西官方应用程序上被选为本场比赛之星，他获得了高达 69% 的选票。埃莉·卡彭特以 24% 的得票率位居第二，她在右翼卫位置上也梅开二度。

news.title: Chelsea Diary: London derbies take centre stage

news.body_en: There are London derbies for both our senior sides in a busy week across Chelsea, while our Academy teams are also in action and there is plenty more to look out for on the Chelsea Official App and website. We begin the week by looking back on the weekend’s action. There will be reaction, highlights and analysis from the men’s Premier League trip to Everton, Chelsea Women’s home Women’s Super League derby against Tottenham Hotspur and Saturday’s Academy fixtures. On Tuesday, we will hear from Danny Welbeck in an interview with award-winning film maker and sport performance expert Leon Mann. This special conversation, marking Black History Month, explores leadership, family, community and the experiences that have shaped our striker’s journey through football. Attention begins to turn towards the weekend’s fixtures, with our men preparing to welcome Tottenham to Stamford Bridge and Chelsea Women getting ready for a trip across London to face Crystal Palace. Thursday marks the 30th anniversary of Matthew Harding’s passing and we will remember the former Chelsea vice-chairman, whose passion for the club and connection with our supporters remain an important part of our history. Later in the day, Sonia Bompastor will face the media at her pre-match press conference ahead of Sunday’s WSL fixture at Crystal Palace. You can follow the key updates on the Chelsea Official App and website, with the full press conference available to watch live on our official channels. Xabi Alonso will sit down with the media for his pre-match press conference, live on the Chelsea Official App and website, as the build-up to Saturday’s meeting with Tottenham gathers pace. We will bring you the latest team news and the head coach’s thoughts ahead of the London derby. There will also be an interview with Lexi Potter, who will discuss her journey, development and ambitions with Chelsea, after making her senior England debut during the international break. It is a packed Saturday for the Blues, beginning at Cobham. Chelsea Under-18s host Ipswich Town in the Under-18 Premier League at 12pm, a game CFC+ subscribers can watch live in our Chelsea Under-18s vs Ipswich Town Match Centre. Next up, Cobham Next Gen welcome Liverpool Under-21s to Kingsmeadow in the Premier League 2 at 2pm. You can follow along with live updates in our Cobham Next Gen vs Liverpool Match Centre, followed by the full match replay for CFC+ subscribers and select highlights. The focus then shifts to Stamford Bridge, where Alonso’s side face Tottenham in the Premier League. The London derby kicks off at 5.30pm, with all the build-up, team news, live updates and post-match reaction available in our Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website. Highlights of Spurs’ visit to west London will be available from 9.30pm, followed by the full match replay at midnight. Along with all the reaction to Saturday’s Premier League game and Academy highlights, we round off the week with another London derby. Chelsea Women travel to face Crystal Palace in the Women’s Super League. Kick-off is at midday and we will have all the build-up, team news, live updates and reaction in our Crystal Palace vs Chelsea Women Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website.
news.body_zh: 在切尔西忙碌的一周里，我们两支成年队都有伦敦德比，而我们的青训队也在行动，切尔西官方应用程序和网站上还有很多值得关注的内容。我们通过回顾周末的行动来开始新的一周。将会有男子英超联赛对阵埃弗顿的比赛、切尔西女子主场对阵托特纳姆热刺的女子超级联赛德比以及周六青训营的比赛的反应、亮点和分析。周二，我们将听到丹尼·维尔贝克 (Danny Welbeck) 接受获奖电影制片人和体育表演专家莱昂·曼 (Leon Mann) 的采访。这场纪念黑人历史月的特别对话探讨了领导力、家庭、社区以及塑造我们前锋足球生涯的经历。人们的注意力开始转向周末的比赛，我们的男队准备在斯坦福桥迎战托特纳姆热刺队，而切尔西女队则准备穿越伦敦迎战水晶宫。周四是马修·哈丁去世 30 周年，我们将缅怀这位前切尔西副主席，他对俱乐部的热情以及与我们支持者的联系仍然是我们历史的重要组成部分。当天晚些时候，索尼娅·邦帕斯托将在周日对阵水晶宫的 WSL 比赛之前的赛前新闻发布会上面对媒体。您可以关注切尔西官方应用程序和网站上的重要更新，并可以在我们的官方频道上观看完整的新闻发布会直播。随着周六与托特纳姆热刺队比赛的准备工作加快进行，哈维·阿隆索将在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上与媒体一起参加赛前新闻发布会。我们将在伦敦德比之前为您带来最新的球队新闻和主教练的想法。莱克西·波特还将接受采访，她将在国际比赛日期间完成英格兰国家队首秀后，讨论她在切尔西的旅程、发展和抱负。对于蓝军来说，周六是一个拥挤的周六，从科巴姆开始。中午 12 点，切尔西 18 岁以下青年队将在 18 岁以下英超联赛中主场迎战伊普斯维奇镇，CFC+ 订阅者可以在我们的切尔西 18 岁以下青年队对阵伊普斯维奇镇比赛中心现场观看这场比赛。接下来，Cobham Next Gen 将于下午 2 点欢迎利物浦 21 岁以下青年队来到 Kingsmeadow 参加英超 2 场比赛。您可以关注我们的科巴姆下一代对阵利物浦比赛中心的实时更新，然后为 CFC+ 订阅者提供完整比赛重播和精选集锦。然后焦点转移到斯坦福桥，阿隆索的球队将在英超联赛中对阵托特纳姆热刺。伦敦德比将于下午 5.30 开始，切尔西官方应用程序和网站上的切尔西对阵托特纳姆热刺比赛中心提供所有赛前准备、球队新闻、实时更新和赛后反应。热刺造访西伦敦的精彩集锦将于晚上 9 点 30 分开始播出，随后将在午夜进行完整比赛重播。除了周六英超比赛和学院亮点的所有反应之外，我们还以另一场伦敦德比结束本周。切尔西女足将在女足超级联赛中迎战水晶宫。比赛将于中午开始，我们将在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上的水晶宫对阵切尔西女子比赛中心提供所有的赛前准备、球队新闻、实时更新和反应。

news.title: Henderson: It is a privilege and honour to play in this team
news.title_zh: 亨德森：能够在这支球队踢球是一种荣幸
news.body_en: Jordan Henderson has explained why the quality of team-mates around him means he is loving life at Chelsea after making his own mark on the pitch in our consecutive wins over Bournemouth and Everton. The midfielder’s introduction to the Chelsea supporters was delayed by an arm injury picked up with England at the FIFA World Cup in the summer, but he has been more than making up for lost time since his return to action. After marking his home debut with two goals and an assist – the first of those goals coming with just one minute on the clock – in the 5-1 win over Bournemouth at Stamford Bridge, he helped us to victory again as we defeated previously unbeaten Everton 2-0 on Saturday. 'I'm loving playing football at the minute,’ beamed Henderson after recording back-to-back wins with the Blues for the first time. ‘I’ve come back in the last month or so from my injury and it’s an absolute privilege and honour to be playing with some of the players in this team. 'I'm just enjoying it, working with them every day and playing with them out on the pitch. There's some top quality, top talent, here, and I really feel like the team's beginning to take shape in terms of the togetherness and everything. 'There's been a lot of new change in the summer – new coaching staff and players coming in – but I really feel that the togetherness is coming, not only in training during the week on the field, off the field as well. That's going to be important for us going forward and I'm loving every second of it.' Henderson won’t be resting on his laurels after those consecutive Premier League victories, though, as he knows there is still plenty more this Chelsea team is capable of if we continue developing under Xabi Alonso. ‘I know we've still got a lot to improve on as a team, but I feel as though in the last couple of weeks we're going in the right direction,’ he added. ‘So, we'll go back to the training ground and keep working hard for the next game.’ Now the focus turns to our next huge clash at Stamford Bridge! Get ready for derby day as we take on London rivals Tottenham Hotspur. Elevate your matchday with Club Chelsea - exclusive VIP experiences on sale now.
news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森解释了为什么他周围队友的素质意味着他热爱切尔西的生活，在我们连续战胜伯恩茅斯和埃弗顿的比赛中，他在球场上留下了自己的印记。这位中场球员因在夏天随英格兰队参加世界杯时手臂受伤而推迟了向切尔西球迷的出场，但自从他回归赛场以来，他已经弥补了失去的时间。在斯坦福桥 5-1 战胜伯恩茅斯的比赛中，他以两粒进球和一次助攻完成了他的主场处子秀，其中第一个进球是在比赛还剩一分钟时打进的，他帮助我们在周六以 2-0 击败了之前不败的埃弗顿，再次取得了胜利。 “我现在很喜欢踢足球，”亨德森在首次带领蓝军取得背靠背胜利后微笑着说道。 “我在上个月左右从伤病中恢复过来，能够与这支球队的一些球员一起比赛是我的绝对荣幸。 “我很享受这样的感觉，每天和他们一起工作，在球场上和他们一起踢球。这里有一些顶尖的素质、顶尖的人才，我真的觉得球队在团结和一切方面都开始成形。 “夏天发生了很多新的变化——新的教练组和球员加入——但我真的感觉到团结即将到来，不仅是在场上一周的训练中，场外也是如此。这对我们的前进很重要，我很享受其中的每一秒。”不过，在连续取得英超联赛胜利后，亨德森不会满足于自己的成就，因为他知道，如果我们在哈维·阿隆索的带领下继续发展，这支切尔西队还有很多能力。 “我知道作为一个团队我们还有很多地方需要改进，但我觉得在过去几周我们正在朝着正确的方向前进，”他补充道。 “所以，我们将回到训练场，继续为下一场比赛而努力。”现在焦点转向我们在斯坦福桥的下一场重大冲突！为德比日做好准备，我们将迎战伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队。与切尔西俱乐部一起提升您的比赛日 - 独家 VIP 体验现已发售。

news.title: Henderson on a ‘vital’ three points and ‘controlled’ performance
news.title_zh: 亨德森谈“至关重要的”三分和“可控”的表现
news.body_en: Jordan Henderson was delighted to continue building momentum by recording back-to-back Premier League victories, with a first clean sheet in that competition to boot. Having brushed Bournemouth aside with an emphatic 5-1 victory at Stamford Bridge last week, Chelsea took that form on the road to inflict Everton’s first defeat of 2026/27, that 2-0 win also our first ever at their new Hill Dickinson Stadium home. With consecutive league wins in our pocket, which lifted us above the Toffees and into fourth in the Premier League standings, Henderson was left understandably satisfied with a job well done by the Blues on Merseyside on Saturday. ‘I thought it was a good performance and a good result in the end,’ said the midfielder. ‘Three points is always vital for us, especially away from home against a tough team who were unbeaten this season. ‘We knew it was going to be a difficult game, but I really liked the performance. I thought defensively we looked solid and we created some good chances to score two nice goals. Overall, I think it was a good day. ‘We wanted to back up last week by going there and putting on a good performance and getting the win, which we did.’ That sense of satisfaction is only enhanced by the feeling that Chelsea are finding the balance that Xabi Alonso had called for, by adding defensive steel to our free-scoring attack, with seven goals scored to one conceded across our last two matches after Saturday’s shut-out. ‘A clean sheet is always important and I know we haven't had enough of them for a while,’ he continued. ‘So to get one is nice, but I thought that overall our defending from start to finish was good. ‘I don't think we gave them too many chances at all, so that was really pleasing. We could have maybe scored one or two more goals, but overall I thought we controlled the game well and it's just about keep building and keep working.’ Henderson also had words of support for Emiliano Martinez, who was stretchered off the field against Everton and later underwent successful surgery on a fractured jaw, wishing our goalkeeper a speedy recovery. ‘All the lads and everyone will be thinking of him, of course, and texting him. So fingers crossed he can be back with us pretty soon because he's a really important figure, not only on the pitch but around the dressing room.’ Now the focus turns to our next huge clash at Stamford Bridge! Get ready for derby day as we take on London rivals Tottenham Hotspur. Elevate your matchday with Club Chelsea - exclusive VIP experiences on sale now.
news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森很高兴能够通过连续两场英超联赛的胜利来继续积聚动力，并在这场比赛中首次保持零失球。上周在斯坦福桥以 5-1 的比分大胜伯恩茅斯后，切尔西以这样的状态在客场击败了埃弗顿，这是 2026/27 赛季的首场失利，这场 2-0 的胜利也是我们在他们的新主场希尔迪金森球场的第一次胜利。我们在联赛中连续获胜，使我们超越太妃糖，在英超积分榜上排名第四，亨德森对蓝军周六在默西塞德郡的出色表现感到满意，这是可以理解的。 “我认为这是一场很好的表现，最终也取得了很好的结果，”这位中场球员说道。 “三分对我们来说始终至关重要，尤其是客场对阵一支本赛季不败的强队。 “我们知道这将是一场艰难的比赛，但我真的很喜欢这场比赛。我认为我们的防守看起来很稳固，我们创造了一些很好的机会，打进了两个漂亮的进球。总的来说，我认为这是美好的一天。 “我们希望上周能够回到那里，打出良好的表现并赢得胜利，我们做到了。”这种满足感只会因为切尔西找到了哈比·阿隆索所要求的平衡而增强，通过在我们的自由得分进攻中增加防守钢铁，在周六停赛后的最后两场比赛中我们打进了 7 球，丢了 1 球。 “零失球总是很重要，我知道我们已经有一段时间没有失球了，”他继续说道。 “所以得到一个很好，但我认为总的来说我们从开始到结束的防守都很好。 “我认为我们根本没有给他们太多机会，所以这真的很令人高兴。我们本来可以再进一两个球，但总的来说，我认为我们很好地控制了比赛，只是继续建设和继续努力。”亨德森还对埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯表示了支持。埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯在对阵埃弗顿的比赛中被担架抬离场，后来成功接受了下巴骨折的手术，祝愿我们的门将早日康复。 “当然，所有的小伙子和每个人都会想着他，并给他发短信。所以祈祷他很快就能回到我们身边，因为他是一个非常重要的人物，不仅在球场上，而且在更衣室里。”现在焦点转向我们在斯坦福桥的下一场重大冲突！为德比日做好准备，我们将迎战伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队。与切尔西俱乐部一起提升您的比赛日 - 独家 VIP 体验现已发售。

news.title: Cuthbert on her return and 'ruthless' Bompastor
news.title_zh: 卡斯伯特回归和“无情”的邦帕斯特
news.body_en: Chelsea captain Erin Cuthbert was delighted to make her return from injury during our 6-2 win over Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on Sunday afternoon. The skipper, who has been working her way back to fitness after a knee problem sustained while on international duty in June, was given a rousing reception by the Blues supporters when she was introduced after an hour on Sunday. Cuthbert took over the armband from previous captain Millie Bright back in August, but had to wait until our 10th match of the campaign to make her first appearance since the news was announced. Call it good fortune or merely a coincidence, but Lauren James scored our third goal only a minute after her introduction, with Sjoeke Nusken following up with our fourth shortly afterwards. 'It was a bit mental, a bit chaotic!' said Cuthbert afterwards. 'I came on, and we scored quite early, so that kind of settled the nerves a little bit. 'It's always tough to come in during a high-pressure game, but I loved every minute of being back on the pitch, and back at Stamford Bridge. When we're playing like that, it's a fun place.' It has been four-and-a-half months of intense rehab work for Cuthbert to regain match fitness and now she is back she understands that she will have to earn her place in the team. 'Honestly, I felt so ready,' the midfielder continued. 'I had a few set-backs here and there during the recovery. I was targeting the start of the season, and it's five weeks in now, so that's how it went for me. 'I've been working hard in the background. It can be hard to be out when the team are doing really well, and although it's great to watch, I just want to be out there helping the team. 'We've got a single game week this week, and no one is going to know what to do with themselves. The competition is going to be high in training. We will have to perform if we want a place in the starting line-up, and that's what you want as a player. 'That's why I've been at a club like Chelsea for so long because I enjoy the competition. We've got so many really good players in the midfield and across the pitch competing in other positions, and I really thrive under pressure. 'Today it was about me coming on and trying to make an impact, and I got booked, so that's one way to make an impact!' Cuthbert went on to detail exactly how head coach Sonia Bompastor drives the standards among the team, and how hard the players have to work to meet her expectations. 'I don't envy the manager's decision because she's got 25 international players to manage, and that's her job,' the captain explained. 'As players, we've got to make her job as hard as we possibly can, and over the course of the season, we are going to need everybody. 'We've got some real tough spells coming up. I think we've got another eight games in this block before the next international break so everybody will get their moment and it's about being ready to take it when it comes. 'Sonia demands standards in training every single day. She pushes you. She wants the best from her team, and she's ruthless. She wants a high press every single second. And if she doesn't get it from the people on the pitch, she'll get it from the people sitting on the side.'
news.body_zh: 周日下午，切尔西队长艾琳·库斯伯特很高兴在斯坦福桥 6-2 战胜托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中伤愈复出。这位队长在六月的国际比赛中膝盖受伤，一直在努力恢复健康，周日一个小时后，当她被介绍时，受到了蓝军支持者的热烈欢迎。卡斯伯特在八月份从前任队长米莉·布莱特手中接过了队长袖标，但直到我们本赛季的第10场比赛，她才在消息宣布后首次亮相。可以说这是好运，也可以说只是巧合，但劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 在登场后仅一分钟就攻入了我们的第三个进球，不久之后，斯乔克·努斯肯 (Sjoeke Nusken) 也攻入了我们的第四个进球。 “这有点精神错乱，有点混乱！”卡斯伯特事后说道。 “我上场了，我们很早就进球了，所以这稍微缓解了我们的紧张情绪。 “在一场高压的比赛中上场总是很困难，但我喜欢回到球场上、回到斯坦福桥的每一分钟。当我们像那样玩耍时，这是一个有趣的地方。”卡斯伯特经过四个半月的紧张康复工作才恢复了比赛状态，现在她回来了，她明白自己必须在球队中赢得一席之地。 “老实说，我感觉自己已经准备好了，”这位中场球员继续说道。 “在康复过程中，我时不时地遇到了一些挫折。我的目标是赛季开始，现在已经五周了，所以这就是我的情况。 “我一直在后台努力工作。当球队表现非常出色时，很难离开，尽管观看比赛很精彩，但我只想上场帮助球队。 “这周我们只有一场比赛，没有人会知道自己该怎么办。比赛的训练强度将会很高。如果我们想在首发阵容中占有一席之地，我们就必须表现出色，而这正是作为一名球员所想要的。 “这就是为什么我在切尔西这样的俱乐部呆了这么久，因为我喜欢比赛。我们在中场和球场上有很多非常优秀的球员，在其他位置上竞争，我真的在压力下茁壮成长。 “今天我上场并试图产生影响，但我得到了黄牌，所以这是产生影响的一种方式！”卡斯伯特接着详细介绍了主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特如何推动球队的标准，以及球员们必须付出多大的努力才能达到她的期望。 “我并不羡慕主教练的决定，因为她要管理 25 名国际球员，而这就是她的工作，”队长解释道。 “作为球员，我们必须让她的工作尽可能地努力，在整个赛季中，我们将需要每个人。 “我们即将面临一些真正艰难的时期。我认为在下一次国际比赛日之前我们还有八场比赛，所以每个人都会得到属于自己的时刻，并且要在它到来时做好准备。 “索尼娅要求每天的训练都达到标准。她推你。她希望她的团队做到最好，而且她很无情。她希望每一秒都受到高压。如果她不能从球场上的人那里得到它，她就会从坐在一边的人那里得到它。

news.title: Bompastor gives Girma update and praises 'unbelievable' Chelsea fans
news.title_zh: 博姆帕斯特向吉尔马通报最新情况并赞扬“令人难以置信的”切尔西球迷
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor was delighted with her side after Chelsea Women's 6-2 win over Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on Sunday afternoon and singled out the impact of the supporters on the team's performance. A brace each from Ellie Carpenter and Lauren James, plus goals from substitutes Maika Hamano and Sjoeke Nusken, contributed to the 6-2 victory on Bompastor's 50th game in the Women's Super League. The result means we continue our unbeaten start to the campaign, with five wins and one draw from our opening six league matches this season. 'I'm pleased with the performance and the result,' said the head coach afterwards. 'I was convinced coming into this game, we would need players who would come in and bring a big impact and fresh legs. 'On the back of the international break, we can talk about the tactical aspects, but it was probably the most important thing to have players who impacted the game the way they did today. So it's good when you have depth in the squad, a lot of players available, and the quality of the players who are coming in.' The fans at Stamford Bridge were treated to a big win for Chelsea on Sunday afternoon, with eight goals scored in total. We are now playing all of our WSL matches at Stamford Bridge and the crowd noise has been excellent throughout. That sentiment was echoed by our head coach. 'The atmosphere today was great in the stadium,' continued Bompastor. 'The fans were unbelievable. It helps when they can see many goals. Both teams need to play well for them to see the quality of football on the pitch. So credit to Chelsea, but also to Tottenham for that. 'I feel like they really enjoyed it, especially with the win at the end and the three points.' Naomi Girma was missing from the squad against Spurs, and Bompastor gave an update on her condition. 'Naomi picked up a small injury in her calf before the international break,' she explained. 'That's why she's out of the squad. But right now I have depth in the squad. I have a lot of high-quality competition.' Praising the contribution of James after her two superb goals this afternoon, Bompastor said: 'When LJ is playing at this level, we are talking about a top-class player, a world-class player. She creates things for herself by herself with the quality she has on the ball. 'It's a big help when you have a player who can create from nothing. I want to also highlight the team performance. When individuals are performing, it's usually because the team is performing as well. The players around her are doing a job for her to express her quality on the ball.' James came into Sunday's clash on the back of a brace for England during Tuesday evening's 5-0 win over Greece. Bompastor explained that her international performances helped fuel today's outstanding display. 'It was a bit more difficult for her before the international break,' said the head coach. 'Going with England was a big boost and I think she played really well, and we are now getting the benefit of that, so it's good.'
news.body_zh: 周日下午切尔西女足在斯坦福桥以 6-2 战胜托特纳姆热刺队后，索尼娅·邦帕斯特对她的球队感到高兴，并特别指出了球迷对球队表现的影响。艾莉·卡彭特和劳伦·詹姆斯分别梅开二度，加上替补球员滨野麦卡和斯乔克·努斯肯的进球，帮助邦帕斯托在女子超级联赛的第 50 场比赛中以 6-2 获胜。这个结果意味着我们继续保持赛季不败的开局，本赛季前六场联赛取得五胜一平。 “我对表现和结果感到满意，”主教练赛后说道。 “我确信参加这场比赛，我们需要能够带来巨大影响和新鲜血液的球员。 “在国际比赛日结束后，我们可以讨论战术方面的问题，但拥有像今天这样影响比赛的球员可能是最重要的事情。因此，当你的球队有深度、有很多可用的球员以及新加入的球员的质量时，这是件好事。”周日下午，斯坦福桥的球迷们见证了切尔西队的一场重大胜利，总共打进了八个进球。现在我们所有的 WSL 比赛都在斯坦福桥进行，整个过程中人群的喧闹声非常好。我们的主教练也表达了同样的观点。 “今天体育场内的气氛非常好，”邦帕斯特继续说道。 “球迷们难以置信。当他们看到很多目标时，这会有所帮助。两支球队都需要打好比赛才能看到球场上足球的质量。这要归功于切尔西，也归功于托特纳姆热刺。 “我觉得他们真的很享受比赛，尤其是最后的胜利和三分。”娜奥米·吉尔玛在对阵热刺的比赛中缺席，邦帕斯特通报了她的最新情况。 “国际比赛日之前，内奥米的小腿受了点小伤，”她解释道。 “这就是她被排除在球队之外的原因。但现在我在球队中有深度。我有很多高质量的竞争。庞帕斯特在今天下午打进两粒精彩进球后赞扬了詹姆斯的贡献，他说：“当LJ打出这样的水平时，我们谈论的是一位顶级球员，一位世界级球员。她凭借自己的球技为自己创造了东西。 “当你拥有一名能够从无到有创造的球员时，这是一个很大的帮助。我还想强调团队的表现。当个人表现出色时，通常是因为团队也在表现出色。她周围的球员正在为她做一份工作，让她展现她的球技。”周二晚上英格兰队5-0战胜希腊队的比赛中，詹姆斯梅开二度，参加了周日的比赛。邦帕斯托解释说，她在国际比赛中的表现有助于推动今天的出色表现。 “国际比赛日之前对她来说有点困难，”主教练说。 “与英格兰队一起比赛是一个很大的推动，我认为她踢得非常好，我们现在正在从中受益，所以这很好。”

news.title: Match report: Chelsea Women 6-2 Tottenham
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西女足 6-2 托特纳姆热刺
news.body_en: A brilliant second-half performance saw Chelsea Women defeat Tottenham Hotspur 6-2 at Stamford Bridge, with a brace each from Ellie Carpenter and Lauren James. Tottenham came into the encounter in good form, aside from a heavy defeat to London City Lionesses before the international break. And early on, they showed exactly why they had risen to fourth in the table as they played with determination from the get-go. Yet it was Chelsea who took the lead thanks to a brilliant solo effort from Lauren James, as she used her skill to drive to the byline and fire a perfect shot over the line from what first looked to be an impossible angle. Away sides often let their heads drop when the Blues take the lead at home, but Spurs stuck to their plan, kept pushing forward and got their reward when Matilda Vinberg headed in from close range. The second half was a different story. A fine finish from Ellie Carpenter put the Blues back in front before another outstanding solo effort from James gave us breathing room with an hour gone. Substitute Sjoeke Nusken smashed in emphatically following some excellent wing play from Alyssa Thompson, before Maika Hamano netted against her former club with a stunning strike from range. Tottenham pulled back a consolation goal with three minutes of normal time remaining, before Carpenter completed her brace with composure in stoppage time. It was a positive day all around for the Blues, as the big win coincided with the first minutes this season for new club captain Erin Cuthbert as she came on after an hour. This Chelsea side seems to be looking more impressive every week. Bompastor made four alterations to her line-up, exchanging Sandy Baltimore, Veerle Buurman, Hamano and Nusken for James, Katie McCabe, Lexi Potter and Thompson. It was Spurs who started on the front foot in the opening minutes, and Hannah Hampton had to be alert and make a save when the space suddenly opened up for Signe Gaupset in a central position. But then the Blues had a chance of our own as Carpenter drove to the byline and put a dangerous ball in across the byline. Striker Melvine Malard received the cross no more than a yard out, but with her back to goal just couldn't steer the ball across the line. Spurs had come to Stamford Bridge ready to fight for every ball. After 15 minutes, there was not much between the sides and the possession counter read at 50 per cent each. With a determined Spurs making things difficult, it took a magnificent solo effort from James to unlock their defence. Stealing the ball from Toko Koga on the left flank, our No10 drove towards the dead-ball line. Most players would've run out of space at the by-line, but not James. Instead, she unleashed a shot with sublime skill and pure power, beating the goalkeeper as the ball crossed the line in the opposite corner. Yet Spurs were undeterred. Kadeisha Buchanan made a key intervention from a Vinberg cross, preventing the ball from reaching the onrushing Cathinka Tandberg as they continued to press forward towards goal. Koga had recovered her composure from losing the ball to James as she made a key block on Carpenter up the other end. Tottenham's persistence paid off shortly before half-time. Arriving late into the final third, Julie Blakstad picked up the ball just outside the penalty area, swinging a cross into the far post. Vinberg rose highest, nodding home from close range to put the visitors level. Spurs came out brightly once again in the second half, but the best chance in the early stages of the second half fell to Chelsea. Lexi Potter's determination in midfield and pass to Malard created an opening for the striker, but her curling effort from the corner of the penalty area went over the bar. Just when the outcome of the contest looked uncertain, Thompson used her pace to breeze past her marker, skipping over a challenge on the edge of the box before squaring the ball to Carpenter. The Australian made no mistake with her powerful finish high into the back of the net, putting the Blues back in front in style. Bompastor then made a triple change. Among the substitutes was Cuthbert, making her first appearance for Chelsea this season, and our new captain received a rousing reception from the Blues supporters in the stands at Stamford Bridge. Cuthbert had been on the pitch for less than a couple of minutes when James took matters into her own hands again. Breaking free of the backpedalling defenders, she burst into the box and used her low centre of gravity to lean backwards and curl another superb shot into the bottom corner. After what had been a truly difficult contest, Chelsea then found yet another gear. Keira Walsh chipped a delicate pass to substitute Nusken, who had found space in the box, and the midfielder lashed in a powerful strike to put us 4-1 in front. The Germany international then almost handed James her hat-trick, but grateful goalkeeper Lize Kop was able to dive on the ball and just about prevent her shot from crossing the line. Spurs proved dangerous in attack once again when Hampton made an excellent save from a Kirsty Hanson shot, and showed the quickest reactions when she collected the follow-up. Facing her former club for the first time since last season's loan spell, Hamano said before the match that her dream is to one day win the prestigious Ballon d'Or trophy. Her 86th-minute strike was certainly worthy of a player of that calibre, netting with a magnificent swerving effort from almost 30 yards out. Those inside the stadium were still recovering from Hamano's brilliant effort when Spurs grabbed a consolation through Gaupset, but there was still more to come from the Blues. The emphatic London derby win was sealed when Walsh picked out Carpenter in the box, and the wing-back then completed her brace with a wonderful turn and finish. A brilliantly entertaining afternoon for the Chelsea faithful at the Bridge. We go top of the WSL table, pending Manchester City's result. We face newly-promoted Crystal Palace in Women's Super League action over at the Borough Sports Ground in Sutton. news.body_zh: 下半场，切尔西女足凭借埃莉·卡彭特和劳伦·詹姆斯的梅开二度，在斯坦福桥以 6-2 击败托特纳姆热刺队。托特纳姆热刺队在这场比赛中状态良好，除了在国际比赛日之前惨败于伦敦城狮队之外。早些时候，他们从一开始就表现出了坚定的决心，从而准确地展示了自己为何能升至积分榜第四。然而，切尔西凭借劳伦·詹姆斯的出色个人表现取得了领先，她利用自己的技术冲向底线，从最初看起来不可能的角度射出一脚完美的射门。当蓝军在主场取得领先时，客队常常会低头，但热刺坚持他们的计划，不断向前推进，并在玛蒂尔达·文伯格近距离头球破门时得到了回报。下半场则是一个不同的故事。艾莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 的精彩射门让蓝军重新回到领先位置，而詹姆斯的另一次出色的个人射门则在一个小时后给了我们喘息的空间。替补球员斯乔克·努斯肯 (Sjoeke Nusken) 在阿丽莎·汤普森 (Alyssa Thompson) 的侧翼出色表现后大力进球，随后滨野麦卡 (Maika Hamano) 凭借一记令人惊叹的远射破门，对阵她的前东家。托特纳姆热刺队在比赛还剩三分钟时扳回一球，扳平比分，卡彭特在补时阶段冷静地完成梅开二度。对于蓝军来说，这是积极的一天，因为这场巨大的胜利恰逢新俱乐部队长艾琳·卡斯伯特本赛季的第一分钟，她在一小时后上场。这支切尔西队似乎每周都显得更加令人印象深刻。邦帕斯特对阵容进行了四次调整，将桑迪·巴尔的摩、维尔勒·布尔曼、哈马诺和努斯肯换成了詹姆斯、凯蒂·麦凯布、莱克西·波特和汤普森。热刺在开场几分钟就取得了领先，当中路的西格涅·高普塞特突然腾出空间时，汉娜·汉普顿必须保持警惕并做出扑救。但随后蓝军获得了自己的机会，卡彭特带球冲向底线，将一记危险的球打入底线。前锋梅尔文·马拉德在距球门不到一码的地方接到传中，但她背对着球门，无法将球带过球门线。热刺来到斯坦福桥已经做好了争夺每一个球的准备。 15分钟后，双方的攻势不多，控球率都显示为50%。由于意志坚定的马刺队让事情变得困难，詹姆斯依靠自己的出色个人努力来解开他们的防守。我们的 10 号球员从左翼的古贺东子 (Toko Koga) 处断球，冲向死球线。大多数球员都会在边线耗尽空间，但詹姆斯不会。相反，她以高超的技巧和纯粹的力量射出一脚射门，当球越过球门线时，她击败了门将。然而热刺并没有被吓倒。卡德沙·布坎南 (Kadeisha Buchanan) 在文伯格 (Vinberg) 传中进行了关键干预，阻止了皮球到达冲上来的卡辛卡·坦德伯格 (Cathinka Tandberg)，同时他们继续向球门推进。科加在球输给詹姆斯后恢复了镇定，她在另一端对卡彭特进行了关键的拦截。托特纳姆热刺的坚持在半场结束前不久得到了回报。进入最后三分之一时，朱莉·布拉克斯塔德在禁区外接球，将球传向远门柱。文伯格站得最高，近距离点头致胜，将客队扳平。下半场热刺再次亮眼，但下半场初期最好的机会落到了切尔西身上。莱克西·波特在中场的决心和传球给马拉德为前锋创造了机会，但她在禁区角的弧线射门却高出了横梁。就在比赛结果看起来不确定时，汤普森利用自己的速度轻松越过了盯防者，跳过了禁区边缘的挑战，然后将球传给了卡彭特。这位澳大利亚人没有犯任何错误，她的强力射门高射入网，让蓝军重新回到领先位置。 Bompastor 随后进行了三次更改。替补球员中包括库斯伯特，这是她本赛季首次代表切尔西出场，我们的新队长在斯坦福桥的看台上受到了蓝军球迷的热烈欢迎。当詹姆斯再次亲自处理此事时，库斯伯特在球场上待了不到几分钟。 她挣脱了后退的防守队员，冲入禁区，利用自己的低重心向后倾斜，将另一记精彩的射门打入底角。经过一场真正艰难的比赛后，切尔西找到了另一个装备。凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 巧妙传球给在禁区内找到空档的努斯肯 (Nusken)，这位中场球员大力射门，我们以 4-1 领先。这位德国国脚随后差点让詹姆斯上演帽子戏法，但心怀感激的门将莉泽·科普(Lize Kop)扑向皮球，差点阻止她的射门越过球门线。当汉普顿对科斯蒂·汉森的射门做出精彩扑救时，热刺再次证明了进攻的危险性，并在她接到后续球时表现出了最快的反应。这是自上赛季租借以来第一次面对她的老东家，滨野在赛前表示，她的梦想是有一天赢得久负盛名的金球奖奖杯。她在第 86 分钟的进球无疑是配得上这样水平的球员的，她在近 30 码外的一脚漂亮的转身射门进球。当热刺通过高普塞特获得安慰时，体育场内的人们还没有从滨野的出色表现中恢复过来，但蓝军还有更多的东西要做。当沃尔什在禁区内挑衅卡彭特时，伦敦德比的胜利就已经锁定了，而这位边后卫则以精彩的转身和射门完成了梅开二度。对于蓝桥的切尔西球迷来说，这是一个精彩有趣的下午。我们在 WSL news.title: Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Tottenham

news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has made four changes to her Chelsea side for our Women's Super League match against Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge this lunch-time. The head coach confirmed in her pre-match press conference that she had no injury issues to contend with, and she has been able to rotate her line-up after a busy international break for our players. Katie McCabe comes in for Veerle Buurman in defence and Lexi Potter, following her senior England debut last Tuesday, replaces Sjoeke Nusken in the XI. Up front, Lauren James - who scored a brace for the Lionesses on Tuesday - replaces Maika Hamano, while Alyssa Thompson is switched for Sandy Baltimore. Club captain Erin Cuthbert is on the bench, having played the full second half in Scotland's 3-2 win over Czechia in midweek. news.title: Hato on Cobham work paying off with ‘solid’ clean sheet
news.title_zh: 哈托谈科巴姆的工作以“扎实”的零失球获得回报
news.body_en: Jorrel Hato was pleased to see the hard work put in on the training pitch in recent weeks come to fruition with an important win at Everton, which he believes provides a strong platform to continue building on. A brace of goals by Pedro Neto at either end of the second half secured our first-ever three points at the Hill Dickinson Stadium and moved us up to fourth place in the Premier League table with a 2-0 victory over the Toffees. However, just as important as the winning goals was the clean sheet at the other end of the pitch, our first in the league of 2026/27 under Xabi Alonso. Speaking after the win, Hato confirmed that shut-out was a key aim for the Blues going into this game and something they had been working hard to achieve on the training pitch at Cobham recently. ‘That was one of our goals,’ said the defender. ‘Of course, we score a lot of goals, everyone knows this, but now we finally have our own clean sheet and as a team it's good. ‘We didn't give many chances away, or big chances, so that's solid and we keep going. Now we have to go forward with it and keep as many clean sheets as we can. ‘When we came back from the international break, everyone knew that we have a good team and we score a lot of goals, but defensively it had to be better. We had to do it, and I think we showed it against Bournemouth and again against Everton.’ That clean sheet arrived despite the loss of Emiliano Martinez during the second half to a nasty injury, with it being confirmed this morning that our goalkeeper has now undergone successful surgery on a fractured jaw. ‘Of course, when a moment like this happens, everyone is in shock. But of course, the game goes on for another 20 minutes. So we were just saying to each other: “stay focused”. I think we did a good job. We scored to make it 2-0 and finish off the game.’ Despite the set-back of losing Martinez, it was a strong second-half showing from the Blues on Merseyside to claim all the points and leapfrog opponents Everton in the standings. Now, Hato is looking to keep building on the momentum from that victory and the previous week’s win over Bournemouth, with a London derby against Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge to come next. ‘I think we started well after the break, and now it’s two games and two wins, so we have to keep going,’ the Dutchman added. ‘There are a lot of games coming, and great games to play as well, so we have to keep going.’ Now the focus turns to our next huge clash at Stamford Bridge! news.body_zh: 乔雷尔·哈托很高兴看到最近几周在训练场上的努力取得了成果，在埃弗顿取得了一场重要的胜利，他相信这为继续前进提供了一个强大的平台。佩德罗·内托在下半场两端的梅开二度帮助我们在希尔迪金森体育场获得了首个三分，并以 2-0 战胜太妃糖队，将英超积分榜提升至第四位。然而，与致胜进球同样重要的是球场另一端的零失球，这是我们在哈维·阿隆索的带领下在 2026/27 赛季联赛中的第一次零失球。获胜后，哈托证实，锁定胜局是蓝军进入这场比赛的一个关键目标，也是他们最近在科巴姆训练场上努力实现的目标。 “这是我们的目标之一，”后卫说。 “当然，我们进了很多球，每个人都知道这一点，但现在我们终于有了自己的零失球，作为一支球队，这很好。 `我们没有放弃很多机会，也没有放弃大机会，所以这很稳固，我们会继续前进。现在我们必须继续前进，并尽可能多地保持不失球。 “当我们从国际比赛日回来时，每个人都知道我们有一支优秀的球队，我们进了很多球，但在防守上必须做得更好。我们必须这么做，我认为我们在对阵伯恩茅斯和对阵埃弗顿的比赛中都展示了这一点。尽管埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯在下半场因严重受伤而失去了比赛，但我们还是取得了不失球的成绩，今天早上证实我们的门将已经成功接受了下巴骨折的手术。 “当然，当这样的时刻发生时，每个人都会感到震惊。当然，比赛还要继续20分钟。所以我们只是对彼此说：“保持专注”。我认为我们做得很好。我们进球了，2-0 结束了比赛。尽管失去了马丁内斯，蓝军在下半场表现出色，在默西塞德郡取得了全部积分，并在积分榜上超越了对手埃弗顿。现在，哈托希望继续利用这场胜利和上周战胜伯恩茅斯的势头，接下来将在斯坦福桥与托特纳姆热刺队进行伦敦德比。 “我认为我们在中场休息后开局不错，现在是两场比赛和两场胜利，所以我们必须继续前进，”荷兰人补充道。 “还有很多比赛即将到来，还有精彩的比赛要打，所以我们必须继续前进。”现在焦点转向我们在斯坦福桥的下一场重大比赛！为德比日做好准备，我们将迎战伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队。与切尔西俱乐部一起提升您的比赛日 - 独家 VIP 体验现已发售。

news.title: Injury update: Emiliano Martinez
news.title_zh: 伤病更新：埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club has released the following update on Emiliano Martinez. Goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez has undergone successful surgery on a fractured jaw. Martinez was injured following a collision midway through the second half of our 2-0 victory over Everton at the Hill Dickinson Stadium on Saturday. Martinez was taken to hospital for further assessment, which confirmed a fractured jaw that required surgery. Everyone at Chelsea wishes Emi a speedy recovery and will support him throughout.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部发布了有关埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯的以下最新消息。守门员埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯的下巴骨折成功接受了手术。周六，我们在希尔迪金森体育场 2-0 战胜埃弗顿的比赛中，马丁内斯在下半场中段发生碰撞后受伤。马丁内斯被送往医院进行进一步评估，确认下巴骨折，需要手术。切尔西的每个人都祝愿埃米早日康复，并将自始至终支持他。

news.title: Alonso outlines Neto’s ‘great qualities’ and why Blues trio pleased him so much
news.title_zh: 阿隆索概述了内托的“伟大品质”以及为什么蓝军三人组如此令他满意
news.body_en: In what was, for long periods, a tight game at the Hill Dickinson Stadium, Pedro Neto’s two well-taken goals made the difference. For Xabi Alonso, it was yet another example of what the Portuguese offers this Chelsea team. With his pair of clinical left-footed finishes against Everton, Neto took his tally for the season to four goals. That figure is already almost half of the ten he notched in 2025/26. There is plenty more to Neto’s game than goals, though. Alonso has deployed him in a right-sided position so far this season. It is a role which allows him to showcase his attacking intent while continually contributing defensively, utilising his work rate and positional discipline. Click to shop the third kit now ‘You can call him whatever – winger, wing-back, attacker, defender – because he can do many things,’ said Alonso. ‘Pedro has great qualities. He’s always a threat, has a great competitive level, he can run, do one-v-ones, can score goals. ‘He’s so competitive. When he’s close to the action, he’s a threat against any full-back. When he’s on the last line or in between, he connects well with the players around, with Joao (Pedro), with Cole (Palmer), with Josh (Acheampong) as well. They worked really well, and I’m happy he could score.’ So far this season it has been the names of Palmer, Joao Pedro and Morgan Rogers that have stolen the headlines. While that trio did not score or assist on Saturday, Alonso was still delighted with their contributions. They led from the front and set the tone for a fantastic collective showing. ‘For me they played a fantastic game,’ he said. ‘They worked really hard. They were helping the team, Morgan on the wing, Cole and Joao in the middle. We need that to win as a team, so many positives from the game.’ Three points secured - now, the focus turns to our next huge clash at Stamford Bridge!
